checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Frames from 0.6 to 5.7 s of a 6 s clip at 826x496, about 1.67:1. That is close to 16:9 and clearly wide.

must.item: Stripes, rocky coast and composition match the first-turn picture
must.why: The lighthouse, rocks, house, pole and sky match the still. The tower drifts and grows slightly, but the match is close.

must.item: Watercolor look and dusk lighting stay throughout
must.why: The paper edges, washes and pink-orange dusk sky are consistent in all frames.

must.item: Waves move against the rocks and a beam sweeps across the water
must.why: The waves show some foam change around the rocks. No beam is visible in any frame. The lantern has only a small stray line.

must.item: No added writing or audible sound
must.why: No text is visible. The video is described as silent, and sound can't be checked from frames.

faults.what: No lighthouse beam appears or sweeps across the water. This was a core request.
A thin stray line or antenna sticks out of the lantern roof and changes between frames. It looks like an artefact.
The whole scene shifts and zooms slightly, and the lighthouse moves position. The wave motion is subtle.

summary: The video keeps the watercolor lighthouse scene faithfully, with gentle wave foam at the rocks, but it shows no sweeping beam, so a main request is missed.
